updates.new_evidence: Provider-neutral local command adapter binds exact task packet, runner identity, generation config delivery, raw stdout/stderr, timing/failures, attempt history and proposal-only authority in immutable receipts.
updates.remaining: Freeze and execute at least one local model and one accessible hosted/provider adapter if available; bind provider-returned model revision/usage without assuming the provider honored settings.

updates.new_evidence: Completed invocations replay from immutable receipt; PREPARED retry policy and RUNNING ambiguity are explicit; local same-invocation lease prevents overlap in the tested single-host model.
updates.remaining: Workflow/DAG-level checkpoints, side-effect classes, experiment idempotency keys and crash recovery across multi-step research remain open.

updates.new_evidence: Reference runtime now covers project state, context compilation, local provider-neutral execution, immutable raw outputs and duplicate-safe local replay.
updates.remaining: Tokenizer calibration, release artifact identity, evaluator dependencies, trace export, fresh environment matrix and empirical scientific benchmarks remain.

updates.problem: Round-023 active.lock is a local-process lease. It does not establish exactly-once execution when multiple hosts or shared/distributed stores can invoke the same experiment.
updates.target: Only if a real deployment requires multi-host execution, freeze distributed lease/idempotency worlds and compare database transaction, queue/idempotency-key and workflow-engine mechanisms before implementation.
updates.falsifier: If the publishable reference profile remains intentionally single-host and reproducible, do not add distributed-systems complexity merely for completeness.

updates.problem: Runner identity currently binds absolute argv and a declared environment revision, but not the executable bytes/container/image or provider-side runtime implementation.
updates.target: Bind locally inspectable executable/file digests or image identities and classify hosted-provider runner identity as externally attested/partially identified rather than exact local artifact identity.
updates.falsifier: If source/package release identity plus provider model/version receipts already separates all registered execution worlds, avoid redundant artifact-attestation layers.

updates.problem: RAKL has immutable local events but no standardized trace export for latency, nested tool calls, model spans and experiment-side effects.
updates.target: Map execution events to a standard trace/span projection while keeping telemetry representation separate from scientific evidence authority.
updates.falsifier: If immutable execution receipts plus raw outputs localize all registered failures at materially lower cost, standardized trace export remains optional infrastructure.

updates.new_requirement: Execution receipts should eventually record measured task-envelope token counts or a declared conservative estimator for the actual adapter/model.
Release manifest should include the execution protocol/reference-runtime revision and artifact-evaluation benchmark identities.
